description: Source code implementing TCP client functionality for an echo client, including socket creation, connection, data transmission, and reception with support for TLS and SOCKS proxy configuration.

methods.name: sendall
methods.description: Sends all data in buffer over socket, handling partial sends.

methods.name: send_tcp_data
methods.description: Generates and sends TCP data, updates expected byte count.

methods.name: compare_tcp_data
methods.description: Compares received data with expected lorem_ipsum pattern.

methods.name: start_tcp_proto
methods.description: Creates and connects a TCP or TLS socket, optionally via SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: process_tcp_proto
methods.description: Processes incoming TCP data, compares, and sends new data.

methods.name: start_tcp
methods.description: Initializes TCP connections for IPv4 and IPv6 if enabled.

methods.name: process_tcp
methods.description: Processes TCP data for IPv4 and IPv6 if enabled.

methods.name: stop_tcp
methods.description: Closes TCP sockets for IPv4 and IPv6 if open.
